html:
The Koinmerburra, also called Guwinmal or Koinjmal, are an Aboriginal Australian people of the central Queensland coast, around Broad Sound north of Rockhampton. The map shows them from 1600 to 1800.

They are the traditional owners of an area that includes part of the Great Barrier Reef. Their country of bays, mangroves and islands gave fish, dugong, turtle and shellfish. Little else is recorded of their history before colonisation. Neighbours on the map include the Barada, the Darumbal and the Yuwi. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
